title: Active Businesses
rawStatement: missing: not in local-reference/leetcode/raw (index marks Missing)
summary: For each event_type, compute the average occurrences across the businesses that have a row for that type. Return each business_id whose occurrences exceed that average for more than one event type. Equality does not qualify.
inputFormat: Events(business_id, event_type, occurrences), keyed by (business_id, event_type).
outputFormat: One column business_id; one row per qualifying business.
edgeRules: Averages are over businesses having a row for the type, not over all businesses. Equality with the average does not count.
